name: Canaria-Issue2-direct-compositional-simplification-digits-v1

replacement_grammar.componentwise: two TinyRes modules, each hidden width h
replacement_grammar.fit_updates: 600 updates per component module and 600 updates for composed module
replacement_grammar.compute_matching_note: two width-h component fits at 600 updates each have approximately the same linear-layer multiply count and exact same parameter-update count as one width-2h composed fit at 600 updates

selection.utility_criterion: replacement validation accuracy >= teacher validation accuracy - 0.02
selection.selected_budget: smallest grid budget satisfying both criteria

primary.H1: composed selected minimum budget is smaller on average

secondary_confirmatory.H2: test accuracy at validation-selected composed budget is noninferior to componentwise
secondary_confirmatory.decision: 95% paired bootstrap CI lower of mean(comp_test_acc-sep_test_acc) > -0.02

mechanistic_secondary.joint_factorized_control: two width8 TinyRes modules jointly fit end-to-end to composed span target for 600 updates; same 2048 params
mechanistic_secondary.purpose: distinguish local component targets from representation-shape effects

overall_pass: H1 PASS and H2 PASS; every seed must have a selected budget for both conditions
